content.short: Kattana is a professional-grade trading terminal for DEXs, offering advanced charting and limit orders for TON.
content.description: Kattana is a high-performance trading terminal designed to bring the tools of professional Wall Street traders to the world of decentralized exchanges. It provides a comprehensive interface for trading on TON-based DEXs, featuring advanced charting tools, technical indicators, and support for automated limit orders. Kattana enables users to manage their multi-chain portfolios with ease, providing real-time data and a seamless trading experience that bridges the gap between traditional finance and decentralized markets.
